purpose: Internal territory assignment records connecting approved partners to operational markets without creating public SEO pages.

roles.primary: Approved primary operator for the defined territory.
roles.backup: Approved backup or overflow operator for the defined territory.
roles.shared: Approved partner eligible for shared opportunities in the defined market without primary-territory status.
roles.waitlist: Future-review record only; not eligible for routed customer contact solely from this role.

assignmentStatuses.pending: Assignment is being reviewed and cannot receive leads.
assignmentStatuses.active: Assignment is approved and eligible for routing according to its role and partner-access policy.
assignmentStatuses.paused: Assignment is temporarily unavailable for new leads.
